steps.text: Board on the Full Map side (used for all player counts)
Remove cards and Distant Cotton Market tiles that don't show your player count, and the 2 read-manual cards
steps.note: 2 players: no blue or teal Location cards; 3 players: no teal

steps.text: Shuffle the cards facedown as the Draw Deck
Deck tile (Stephenson's Rocket side up) near the bottom of the Draw Deck with {n} cards beneath it
Shuffle the Distant Cotton Market tiles facedown on the Tile Draw Area; marker on the top space of its track
A black cube on every Coal Market space and an orange cube on every Iron Market space
Remaining cubes as the General Supply; money as the Bank
Each player takes a Player Mat and {n} pounds
Choose a Character tile; matching Link tiles in your area
Stack your Industry tiles on their mat slots, black-top side facedown
VP marker on 0 and Income marker on 10 of the Progress Track
Draw {n} cards as your hand; leave room for a discard pile
Shuffle all Character tiles onto the Turn Order Track in random order
Canal Era, round 1: follow the Turn Order Track
